Subject: FinServe discovery recap + procurement & onboarding checklist

Hi Laura — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so procurement has a single place to reference.

High-level
- Use case: Embed LLM-powered summary + search for internal customer support KB (low PII).
- Expected initial QPS: 600 requests/day, spikes to ~3k/day during incident windows.
- Decision criteria: latency under 250ms p50, SOC2 evidence for security, predictable monthly billing (PO-friendly).

Stakeholder mapping (as we heard today)
- Economic buyer: Michael Park (CFO) — controls budget and PO issuance.
- Procurement lead: Tom Gallagher — vendor onboarding and PO/invoice requirements.
- Security reviewer: Sarah Lowe (infosec) — will validate SOC2 + network controls.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) We will send: vendor onboarding form + draft commercial terms + SOC2 snapshot (attachments below) by end of day Mar 7. (Owner: Marcus / Aisha)
2) Can you confirm: PO process (portal vs PDF), billing address, remit-to, and whether a W-9 is required? Also target approval date from Michael. (Owner: Laura)
3) Schedule: Procurement approval target = week of Mar 22, PO issuance by Mar 25 — is that still accurate? If timeline slides we’ll plan interim sandbox access.
4) Security: Aisha to follow up with SSO/SAML and data retention notes; Sarah to share any required forms.

Attachments referenced
- [Attachment: vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 42 KB)]
- [Attachment: commercial-terms-draft.pdf (application/pdf, 85 KB)]

Proposed short meeting: 30m on Mar 10 to review procurement questions and security checklist. I’ll draft a calendar invite once Laura confirms.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Laura / Marcus — quick follow on the security and integration side. Thanks for confirming the stakeholders. A few technical items we typically see on procurement/security reviews: 

1) SOC2 evidence — we’ll provide the latest SOC2 Type II snapshot and a short memo describing scoping (production inference only; no customer PII stored by default).
2) SSO / SAML — we support IdP-initiated SAML and SCIM for account provisioning. If you want we can provide a short runbook for SSO setup during onboarding.
3) Data retention and logs — default inference logs are retained 30 days; we can discuss longer retention or custom export for audit purposes if required.

I attached a short SSO setup guide and will follow up with the SOC2 snapshot and the vendor onboarding form (filled) by end of day Mar 7 as Marcus noted. If Sarah (FinServe security) has a checklist, please share and I’ll map items to our controls.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-sso-setup-guide.pdf (application/pdf, 12 KB)]

Thanks — Aisha
